I’m ready to generate the SOAP note, but I don’t have the actual content yet. Please provide:

- The transcript (doctor–patient dialogue) with all relevant details.
- The Differential Diagnosis (DDx) in JSON format as described.

Once I have those, I will produce a concise, professional SOAP note with the exact headings:

Subjective:
- Presenting complaint, onset, duration, progression
- Past medical history, surgeries (if applicable)
- Medications (with dose/route/frequency if provided; otherwise note “dose/route/frequency not documented”)
- Social history (if applicable)
- Allergies

Objective:
- Physical exam findings (include side, site, specific findings)
- Vitals and any investigations/results (only if provided)

Assessment & Plan:
1. Issue/Problem/Request 1 (name only):
   - Assessment (likely diagnosis name)
   - Differential diagnosis (from DDx only if consistent; mark “conflict noted” if conflicting)
   - Investigations planned (if any)
   - Treatment planned (if any)
   - Referrals (if any)
2. Issue/Problem/Request 2 (name only):
   - same subpoints
3. Issue/Problem/Request 3, 4, 5, etc. (as applicable)

Quality checks (included at bottom):
- Note any missing but clinically expected elements (e.g., allergies, meds reconciliation)
- Note internal conflicts between transcript and DDx (mark “conflict noted” if any)
- Brief comment on transcript quality if needed

Please paste the transcript and the DDx JSON, and I’ll generate the note accordingly in American English with concise, professional bullet points.
